verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a native AI question-answering feature in Shortcut that returns instant answers with citations from workspace content. The MCP server and the guides for connecting external agents like Codex CLI, Cursor, or Claude Code are developer building blocks or user-side workarounds, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask AI a question and get an instant answer with citations from my workspace content
